decisions.reason: As a core upholstery fabric with a dedicated product page and a strong fit to the firm's established range, it is likely to stay despite ongoing portfolio discipline.
It supports the decorative collection well, but its lower website prominence and possible overlap with other sheer decorative fabrics leave it somewhat exposed to rationalization.
Its more niche double-face wool-blend positioning and the firm's push toward simpler, more sustainable collections make it the most likely candidate to be removed.
As a newly launched fabric with its own page and broad use across upholstery and curtains, it fits the firm's design-led core offer and should be retained for further market development.
